snippet.description:
#LifeInLooks #TheDevilWearsPrada2
영화 '악마는 프라다를 입는다'를 대표하는 배우 메릴 스트립과 앤 해서웨이. 
그리고 두 배우를 만나기 위해 오랜 팬인 장원영이 앤디 스타일로 등장했습니다.

세 사람이 ‘Life in Looks’를 통해 패션에 대한 이야기를 함께 나눴는데요. 
생애 첫 패션쇼에 참석한 메릴 스트립, '악마는 프라다를 입는다 2' 촬영 중 계단에서 넘어진 앤 해서웨이의 생생한 비하인드까지 담았습니다. 

촬영이 끝난 뒤 메릴의 제안으로 완성된 'Bye, Vogue'. 
세 아이콘이 함께한 순간을 오직 '보그 코리아'에서 확인해보세요.

snippet.description:
#VogueExclusive
앤 해서웨이가 '보그 코리아'를 위해 전한 특별한 메시지. 

영화 '악마는 프라다를 입는다' 첫 번째 이야기 이후 약 20년의 시간이 흐른 지금, 수많은 변화 속에서도 여전히 변하지 않는 것들이 있죠. 미란다와 앤디, 그리고 다시 시작될 이야기. 오는 4월 29일, 극장에서 직접 확인해보세요.

en-US.description:
#MYVOGUE #TAEYONG

We reveal the contents of Taeyong's bag, capturing his daily life exactly as it is.

From a new bag purchased in place of the one naturally passed down to his mom and sister, to his pre-stage routine items like massage balls and candies.

We've also included Taeyong's perfume preferences, as he loves citrus scents, and his unique way of using them—specifically, the method of 'not spraying them on his body.'

Taeyong's real items, where even his smallest habits have a reason.

Check out Taeyong's What's in My Bag now.

en-US.title: Why Meryl Streep, Anne Hathaway, and Jang Won-young Gathered at ‘Vogue Korea’? | LIFE IN LOOKS
en-US.description:
#LifeInLooks #TheDevilWearsPrada2

Meryl Streep and Anne Hathaway, the iconic actors representing the movie *The Devil Wears Prada*.

And Jang Won-young, a longtime fan, appeared in Andy Style to meet the two actresses.

The three shared stories about fashion through ‘Life in Looks.’

We captured everything from Meryl Streep attending her first-ever fashion show to the vivid behind-the-scenes of Anne Hathaway falling down the stairs during the filming of *The Devil Wears Prada 2*.

The photo shoot concluded with 'Bye, Vogue,' a result of Meryl's suggestion.

Check out the moments these three icons shared, exclusively at Vogue Korea.

Digital Editor | Jang So-ra

Editing | Kang Su-ji

Design | Han Da-hye

Meryl Streep and Anne Hathaway, the iconic duo from The Devil Wears Prada, meet longtime fan Jang Wonyoung who makes a surprise appearance in her take on Andy’s style.
